title: Un verre d'eau  (A Glass of Water)

segments.t: Catching her breath in her office chair, pregnant agent Andrea receives a glass of water from loyal colleague Gabriel. As her physical discomfort subsides, Gabriel urges her to moderate her intense working schedule for her child's sake. Let's listen to their intimate conversation in French first.
Voici ton verre d'eau fraîche, Andréa.
C'est bon, la contraction est passée.
Bois un peu d'eau, doucement.
Merci Gabriel, je me sens déjà mieux.
Tu as souvent de telles douleurs?
Parfois, quand je marche trop vite.
Tu devrais vraiment ralentir le rythme.
Impossible avec tous mes rendez-vous importants!
La santé de ton bébé passe avant.
Je le sais bien, mon cher Gabriel.
Promets-moi de te reposer ce soir.
D'accord, je vais rentrer plus tôt.
Je surveillerai ton départ du bureau.
Tu es vraiment un ami formidable!
Let's observe how Gabriel expresses protective concern for Andrea's wellbeing.
Voici ton verre d'eau fraîche, Andréa.
'Here is your glass of fresh water, Andrea.' Gabriel introduces refreshing water.
C'est bon, la contraction est passée.
'It is fine, the contraction has passed.' Andréa confirms relief.
Bois un peu d'eau, doucement.
'Drink a little water, gently.' Gabriel advises calm hydration.
Merci Gabriel, je me sens déjà mieux.
'Thank you Gabriel, I already feel better.' Andréa thanks Gabriel and says she already feels better.
Tu as souvent de telles douleurs?
'Do you often have such pains?' Gabriel inquires about recurring symptoms.
Parfois, quand je marche trop vite.
'Sometimes, when I walk too fast.' Andréa explains physical exertion.
Tu devrais vraiment ralentir le rythme.
'You should really slow down the pace.' Gabriel advises professional restraint.
Impossible avec tous mes rendez-vous importants!
'Impossible with all my important meetings!' Andréa defends a demanding schedule.
La santé de ton bébé passe avant.
'The health of your baby comes first.' Gabriel advocates maternal care.
Je le sais bien, mon cher Gabriel.
'I know it well, my dear Gabriel.' Andréa acknowledges sincere advice.
Promets-moi de te reposer ce soir.
'Promise me to rest tonight.' Gabriel requests domestic rest.
D'accord, je vais rentrer plus tôt.
'All right, I am going to go home earlier.' Andréa agrees to go home earlier to rest.
Je surveillerai ton départ du bureau.
'I will keep an eye on your departure from the office.' Gabriel promises to make sure she leaves the office on time.
Tu es vraiment un ami formidable!
'You are truly a wonderful friend!' Andréa celebrates steadfast friendship. Now let's listen to Gabriel and Andrea again at full speed.

Gabriel secures a promise from Andrea to head home early, showing how deep friendship endures beneath agency rivalries. When you watch the episode, listen out for the expressions meaning 'drinking glass' and 'drinking water'. You'll catch them now. See you next time!
À demain!
